pattern: て敵わない（てかなわない）
purpose: Complain that a sensation or condition is too strong to bear.
keywords: い-adjective くて / な-adjective で / Vて + かなわない
The construction next door is unbearably noisy.
formation: い-adjective くて / な-adjective で / Vて + かなわない
restrictions: Often used for heat, noise, pain, or inconvenience.
mistake: This かなわない is not a comparison of ability with an opponent.
